name: Engineered Hardwood Flooring
short_description: Wire brushed European White Oak engineered hardwood with a 3.5mm veneer and 50-year finish warranty. Available in multiple collections, widths, and colors.
use_case: Installs as the primary floor surface in living rooms, bedrooms, hallways, and open-concept spaces over wood subfloor or concrete.

name: Stair Treads
short_description: Unfinished European White Oak stair treads, 1-1/16" thick × 11.5" wide, available in multiple lengths from 36" to 72".
use_case: Replaces the horizontal walking surface of each stair step to match the flooring species and be finished on-site.

name: Stair Risers
short_description: Unfinished European White Oak risers, 0.75" thick × 7.5" wide, available in multiple lengths.
use_case: Covers the vertical face between stair steps for a clean, finished staircase appearance.

name: Stair Nose
short_description: Matching stair nose profiles that cap the exposed leading edge of flooring where it meets the top or intermediate stair step.
use_case: Caps the exposed edge of flooring at the top of a stair step for a safe, finished transition.

name: Reducer
short_description: Matching wood reducer moldings that transition hardwood flooring down to an adjacent lower-height surface.
use_case: Transitions flooring down to a lower surface like tile or carpet at room thresholds and doorways.

name: T-Molding
short_description: Matching T-molding profiles that bridge two floors of equal height at doorways or open room transitions.
use_case: Bridges two equal-height flooring surfaces at doorways or room transitions for a seamless, clean look.

name: End Cap
short_description: Matching end cap moldings that provide a finished termination where hardwood flooring meets a wall, step, or vertical surface.
use_case: Finishes a flooring edge against a wall or vertical surface where no transition to another floor is needed.

name: Baby Threshold
short_description: Low-profile matching wood thresholds for doorway transitions where minimal height change is required.
use_case: Creates a smooth low-profile transition at doorways between same-level or near-same-level surfaces.

name: Wood Vents / Registers
short_description: Matching wood floor vents and registers milled from the same species as the flooring for a seamless, integrated look.
use_case: Replaces standard metal floor vents with matching wood for a seamless, high-end look throughout the space.

name: Custom Profiles
short_description: Made-to-order custom milled trim profiles to match any Calwood flooring product — any species, finish, and profile shape.
use_case: Made-to-order trim profiles to match any Calwood flooring product where a standard profile does not fit the project.
